[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
Martha Glasgow was baptised on 6 August 1809 at Lloyd Street Presbyterian Chapel, Manchester, Lancashire. The index reports a birth on 11 May 1809 and names her parents as William Glasgow and Ann; it does not give Ann’s maiden surname.<ref name="martha1809">[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9841/records/86820999 Ancestry, England, Select Births and Christenings, 1538–1975, Martha Glasgow: birth 11 May 1809, baptism 6 August 1809, Lloyd Street Presbyterian Chapel, Manchester; father William Glasgow, mother Ann]. Index transcript; original register RG4/3128 uninspected.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Probable father identification ===
Her named father is probably [[Glasgow-3545|William Glasgow]], assessed at 84% subjective confidence. He married Ann Denham at Manchester on 30 September 1805.<ref name="marriage1805">[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9852/records/10952888 Ancestry, England, Select Marriages, 1538–1973, William Glasgow and Ann Denham, 30 September 1805, Manchester]. Index transcript.</ref> The same William-and-Ann parental names occur at Lloyd Street for Robert in 1806, Agnus in 1812 and William in 1816. Martha’s 1809 entry fits this household sequence.<ref name="robert1806">[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9841/records/122660630 Ancestry, England, Select Births and Christenings, 1538–1975, Robert Glasgow, baptism 28 September 1806, Lloyd Street Presbyterian Chapel, Manchester; parents William and Ann]. Index transcript.</ref><ref name="agnus1812">[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9841/records/2392597 Ancestry, England, Select Births and Christenings, 1538–1975, Agnus Glasgow, baptism 3 January 1812, same chapel; parents William and Ann]. Index transcript.</ref><ref name="william1816">[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9841/records/183640583 Ancestry, England, Select Births and Christenings, 1538–1975, William Glasgow, baptism 23 June 1816, same chapel; parents William and Ann]. Index transcript.</ref>

This is a probable household identification, not an explicit statement linking Martha to the 1805 groom. Another same-name couple is not excluded. Ann Denham is not assigned as Martha’s mother solely because she married the proposed father; Martha’s recorded mother is Ann, surname unproved. No later marriage, adult identity, death or descendants for Martha are established here. Inspect the original register for an address, trade or maternal surname that distinguishes the family.
